descriptionFull: The Carolina chickadee ( Poecile carolinensis ) is a small passerine bird in the tit family Paridae. It is often placed in the genus Parus with most other tits, but mtDNA cytochrome b sequence data and morphology suggest that separating Poecile more adequately expresses these birds' relationships (Gill et al. , 2005). The American Ornithologists' Union has been treating Poecile as distinct genus for some time already.
